## Owner voice and launch-film timing

- Record your own voice directly against a launch film's music-only mix. Walkcast ducks the score under speech and creates a separate MP4 while keeping both existing mixes.
- Add pronunciation pairs for brand and feature names, choose narration pace and motion pace, and shift chapter cues slightly ahead of or behind recorded page changes.
- Deleting a recording now removes every saved launch-film variant too.
